flavorNote: These add-ons are for The Burning Crusade (2.4.3). WoW VoiceOver and FonzAppraiser are listed for reference and can't be installed yet. Add-ons that live inside a larger collection are reference only too; install those by hand from the collection.

addons.name: Android Port
addons.description: Controller-first interface built for the handheld's 6-inch screen: twin 8-button action clusters (face buttons 1-4, D-pad 5-8) with four modifier layers (none, Shift, Ctrl, Ctrl+Shift) for 32 reachable slots, honoring stances and the stealth/bonus bar. On this client the action tiles are secure buttons driven by the engine, so casts work in and out of combat; drag spells or items onto a tile to assign them out of combat. Buttons show icons, stack counts, cooldown sweeps, and range/mana tinting. An 8-wedge radial menu (F12 / Select) covers Character, Inventory, Spellbook, Talents, Quest Log, World Map, Talk and Move UI, chosen with the same face/D-pad keys. Move UI (F8 / Select+Start) puts a drag handle on every visible stock or add-on window and minimap icon: drag to move, mouse wheel or D-pad Left/Right to scale 50-150%, D-pad Down/Up to cycle focus; layouts persist account-wide (SavedVariables) and /ap resetui restores stock. Move UI waits until combat ends on this client. The five bag windows become one all-in-one bag (All / per-bag / keyring views, bag equip from the header, quality-colored slots, money readout); items are used through the stock secure item buttons, so they work in combat too. Automatic gray-item selling is only available on the 1.12 client. A minimal chat plus an XP/rested strip docked under the player frame (hidden at 70), F7 nearby-interact for the nearest NPC or object without pointer aim, F9 auto-run toggle, and a per-module fail-safe that restores stock UI on any error instead of breaking the game. A WoW Forever layout (the WoW Forever controls in Pocket Realm, or /ap layout forever) keeps all four sets on screen with D-pad slots on the left and face slots on the right, and fixes the base set's face buttons to jump, use, menu and cancel. Chat commands: /ap radial, /ap layout, /ap chat, /ap bags, /ap restore (pre-install key bindings), /ap resetui, /ap off|on <bars|radial|mover|hud|bags> for module toggles. Text entry continues to use Pocket Realm's Android keyboard.
addons.communitySignal: New Pocket Realm built-in; not externally rated
addons.maintenance: Built into Pocket Realm / clean-room implementation
addons.compatibilityNotes: Project-owned add-on with 1280x720 and 1920x1080 six-inch layouts, controller-button chrome, four action layers and no touch sidebars or add-on keyboard. The 32 controller keys ride override bindings over secure action buttons; the stock bars (including the two right bars) step aside out of combat, and a mid-combat shapeshift re-points the first page the moment combat ends. RP6 M1/M2 rear buttons are intentionally disabled because they can latch on some units. Disable other action-bar replacements. Includes its own Move UI (Select + Start) for stock frames and add-on icons, so external frame movers are optional. Native DLL payloads are not used. Switching aspect resets customized control layouts once.

recommendationReasons.151: Controller bars, bags, radial menu and Move UI built for the handheld; installed by default and safe in combat on this game version.
recommendationReasons.059: Voiced quest text. Listed for reference: the voice pack for this version has not been released yet.
recommendationReasons.002: Standalone quest database that reduces map-search and keyboard friction on a 5.5-inch display.
recommendationReasons.001: Full replacement UI whose 2.4.3 theme keeps the Blizzard layout while consolidating bars, bags and nameplates for one-hand play.
